# Multiplayer UI notes (lane ui, 2026-10-12)

In-game interface for the lockstep mod, build 25846389, arm64. Built from the game's own widgets
(Object.Instantiate of real buttons and texts, the game's toast `HelpNoticeView.Show`) and 22 hooks.
Nothing was run in the game. Everything below "Verify in game" is unproven.

## Files
- `ui_model.h/.c`: the rules, with no game code: claims, order permission, vote view, status line, popup routing, story vote tally, address parsing.
- `ui_test/`: `make -C src/ui_test test` (ASan + UBSan, under 1 s): 330 checks pass. Covers vote tally, claim rules (checked against a copy of the dsnet OWNERSHIP rule for every state of a 3-player game), popup routing, story votes (ties, a player leaving, determinism over 200 random command streams), wire format and addresses.
- `ui_game.c`: hooks and widgets (dylib only). Compiles clean with `-Wall -Wextra` for arm64. A trial link of the whole tree into one dylib had no duplicate symbols.
- `ui_mp.h`: the contract with the other lanes (below).

## Integration (lead / mpglue / netcore / orders)
1. `build.sh`: add `ui_game.c ui_model.c`.
2. Call `ui_install()` from the add-image callback, after `mp_game_install()` and `ord_install()`. Call `ui_frame()` once per MainFlow.Update, for example at the end of `rig_frame()`. It must also run on the title screen.
3. **mpglue (mp_game.c)**: add `mp_session *mp_game_session(void)`, `int mp_game_host(const mp_config*)`, `int mp_game_join(const mp_config*)` and `int mp_game_steam_invite(void)`. Today the session only starts from `mp.json`. The title buttons need a way to set `cfg` + `cfg_ok` at run time and to install the speed hooks then (or always).
   - Host: the session runs once a campaign is loaded.
   - Join: connect, then the save arrives through the resync path.
4. **netcore (dsnet)**: add three read-only getters over `simstate`:
   - `dsnet_present_mask(c)`
   - `dsnet_vote_of(c, player, &speed, &pause)`
   - `dsnet_player_name(c, player)`

   Names are not sent today. The server has `c->name`: put it in the PLAYER_JOIN payload, keep it in `simstate`, and include it in the save header.
5. **mp_core**: `run_order` must skip the unit-owner check for order type `UI_ORDER_STORY_VOTE` (3). Its handler applies the story rule itself. Without this change, only the host's votes get through.
6. **orders (ord_mp.c emit)**: `if (!ui_check_order(owner)) return;` before `mp_order`. This blocks orders for another player's unit (or for an unclaimed unit, for a non-host) on the local peer, with a notice. mp_core still drops such orders on every peer.
7. The other lanes' functions are weak imports. When one is missing, the feature turns itself off (the notice reads "not available in this build"). If the final link has a missing one, add `-Wl,-U,_name`.
8. Stub budget: the rig cave has room for 80 hooks. Current use is about 3 (rig) + 16 (det) + 3 (mp) + 22 (ord) + 22 (ui) = about 66.

## What the player sees
- **Title screen**: a "Multiplayer" button under "Load campaign" (a clone of "Credits"). It opens a sub-menu built from more clones:
  - "Host game"
  - "Join <ip:port>"
  - "Paste address" (from the clipboard)
  - "Allow speed-up: On/Off"
  - "Allow pause: On/Off"
  - "Back"

  While hosting, "Host game" becomes "Invite friends (Steam)". The main button shows "Multiplayer (hosting, port N)" or "(joining ...)". Name, address and port are prefilled from `mp.json` when it exists. There is no text input field yet; the address comes from the clipboard (see "Open").
- **Unit pick**: right-click a unit portrait on the shortcut bar.
  - Player: an unclaimed unit is claimed, your own unit is released, and another player's unit gives "X belongs to B". A 4th claim gives "You already control 3 units".
  - Host: each right-click moves the unit to the next owner: unclaimed, host, then each present player with room, then unclaimed.
  - Owner tag: " [Name]" in the player's colour, on the portrait name and on the name above the unit in the world. Tags refresh when ownership changes.
- **Votes**: the stock speed and pause buttons already vote (mp_game hooks). A new line under the clock (a clone of its time text) shows "Paused by the owner, B" or "Speed 2x, held by B". With speed-up off, the 2x and 3x buttons are hidden. With pause off, the pause button is hidden.
- **Status line**: "Connecting to host...", "Waiting for the host's game...", "Resyncing with host..." or "Resyncing with host... (loading)".
- **Popups (owner rules)**:
  - Level-up and trade open only on the owner's peer (unclaimed unit: the host) and never pause. The time lock is removed for `LevelUpView` and `TradeUIView` in multiplayer. Other peers get "X is trading (B)".
  - Story popups open everywhere and pause as in the stock game. If the event has a unit, its owner (unclaimed: the host) chooses. The others see "B is choosing" in small text under the title, and their clicks are blocked with that notice.
  - Story with no unit: everybody clicks to vote. The title shows "Vote: n of m players (the host breaks a tie)".
  - A decided choice is pressed only on the host (stock `OnClickChoice`). Its SelectChoiceRequested then travels as a normal host order.

## Map-change vote (lead request 2026-10-12)
- The transitions lane calls `ui_map_propose(kind, order, len)` when it captures a UI map change in multiplayer (kind 1 = enter dungeon, 2 = return to base, 3 = next floor). It does not send the order itself: ui sends `MAP_PROPOSE` (mp order type 4, zero guid; args `u32 id, u8 kind, u16 len, order`).
- Every peer opens the proposal in command order. The proposer counts as yes. The other peers get the game's own Yes/No box (`CommonNoticeView.Show_Select`, raw text "B wants to go down to the next floor. Agree?"). The answer goes out as `MAP_VOTE` (type 5; `u32 id, u8 accept`).
- The decision comes once every present player has voted. More yes = go, more no = stay, a tie goes to the host's vote. A player who leaves triggers a recheck. Only one proposal can be open at a time.
- On yes, the host's peer calls weak `trn_submit_map_change(order, len)` from `ui_frame`. The order then runs as a host order on every peer. The box is closed everywhere once the vote is decided.
- While a peer loads: the status line shows "Waiting for B, C (loading)" from weak `dsnet_busy_mask()` (the busy bit in transitions_design.md 3.7).
- mp_core must skip the owner check for ui order types 3, 4 and 5.
- Hooks: `CommonNoticeView.Init` 0xF64AB4 (keeps the view), `OnClick_Confirm` 0xF65A18 and `OnClick_Cancle` 0xF65638 (turn the click into a vote, then the stock close).
- **Verify in game:** `Show_Select` followed by `SetActive(true)` really shows the box (the stock code may open it through `StaticViewContainer`), and `_onComplete` closes it.

## Prefab truth (UnityPy, uiprefab bundle + monoscripts bundle, 2026-10-12)
| Prefab | Class | _timeLock | _keyLock | _hasBackgroundExit |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| LevelUp | LevelUpView (PopUpUI_Base) | 1 | 0 | 0 |
| TradeUI | TradeUIView (PopUpUI_Base) | 1 | 1 | 1 |
| RenameUnitUI | RenameUnitView | 1 | 0 | 0 |
| EventNodeUI | EventNodeUIView (EssentialPopUpUI_Base: no flag, always pauses) | - | - | 0 |

- `PopUpUI_Base.SetTimeLock` 0xF5A538 sends UIInput 97 (AddGamePauseReason) with PopupTimeLock (4), then UIInput 95 with 1.
- `EssentialPopUpUI_Base.SetTimeLock` 0xF59E20 sends UIInput 97 with EssentialPopup (1).
- So today trade and level-up DO pause. In multiplayer, ui removes those pauses.

## Story vote message (for the lead)
- An mp order with type `UI_ORDER_STORY_VOTE` = 3 and a zero guid.
- Args, 5 bytes: `u32 node` (FNV-1a of the node's choice keys `_currentChoices`, never 0), `u8 choice`.
- Every peer feeds it to `ui_story_vote` in command order:
  - The chooser is `ui_story_chooser(owner of the event's first UnitEntity)`.
  - Chooser mode: only the chooser's vote counts.
  - Vote mode: decided when every present player has voted. The most votes wins. A tie goes to the host's choice if the host's choice is in the tie, otherwise to the lowest tied index. A leaver triggers a recheck.
- When decided, the host presses the choice from `ui_frame` (not inside the command).

## Verify in game (first run)
1. Title: the clones appear and are clickable. Their text stays ours (no localization component resets it on language refresh). Layout: if the menu has no layout group, `title_layout_frame` stacks them by hand (logged). Does `MainFlow.Update` (so `ui_frame`) run on the title screen?
2. Right-click on a portrait reaches `OnPointerClick` with button 1, and the stock code does nothing harmful with it.
3. The world name (`UnitEntityHUD._nameText`) shows rich-text colour. Is it visible all the time or only on hover/zoom?
4. Level-up skipped on a peer: `DeactivateView(21)` later on that peer is harmless. Presenters do not push view updates to a view that never opened.
5. Trade open while the game runs (no time lock): the refresh timer, drags and commit work; commit re-checks range (code truth, PLAN).
6. Story:
   - `_satisfiedUnits` is filled when `SetEventUI` runs.
   - Every peer computes the same node hash.
   - The host's deferred `OnClickChoice` goes through the orders lane as a host order.
   - The title line does not break the layout.
7. The clock status line position (pos.y minus text height minus 4) is readable and not hidden behind other panels.
8. `HelpNoticeView` exists in base and dungeon scenes (InitOnCreate called).

## Open (needs a decision or another lane)
- **No text input for the address**: it comes from the clipboard or `mp.json`. A real field could be cloned from `SubUI_CampaignSetting._campaignNameInputField` (TMP_InputField, new-campaign screen) or `RenameUnitView._nameInputField` (popup). Not done.
- **Story pause with "Allow pause: Off"** (owner 2026-10-12: story popups always pause everyone). Done on the ui side: with pause off, the story popup's open (`ActivateView` 22) sends `DSNET_STORY_PAUSE` 1 through `dsnet_submit`, and its close (`DeactivateView` 0xF62A88, hook 19) sends 0. With pause on, the existing EssentialPopup vote does the job. **dsnet must:**
  - accept type 10 from any playing player, whatever `allow_pause` says;
  - keep `story_pause[player]` in simstate (reset on join and leave, saved with the state);
  - make `dsnet_ticks_per_step` return 0 while any present player holds it;
  - expose it with `dsnet_story_pause_mask()`.

  The status line then shows "Paused for a story event".
- **Race**: a story vote can arrive on a peer before its own popup shows the node, if several steps run in one frame. The tally still keys on the node hash and uses the event unit known at that moment. This is safe for the decision (only the host acts), but the chooser can be stale if the previous event's unit is still stored. Low risk, because the popup votes pause first.
- **Owner counts for the right-click cycle** come from the units on the shortcut bar. dsnet still enforces the real limit, and a refused claim is silent.

## Escape closes our boxes (owner after lan_v8, 2026-10-14)
- Hook InputEventHandler.OnEvent(EscapeActionRequested) 0xD94930 (local only: ord never sends it). One Escape closes the
  top box of ours and stops: lend menu, then the panel's settings box (cog), then it folds the viewer box to its title
  line ("(click for options)"; a click unfolds it; the next watching starts unfolded). A tooltip is hidden too, but it
  does not stop the Escape. With none of ours open, the game's Escape runs (its popups, then the Esc menu).
- Text fields: no key blocking in ui_game.c. The game makes no key events while KeyInputDispatcher.IsTextInputFocused
  0xD42BBC is true (mpmenu.c h_textfocus: chat, lobby rules, Teams modal), so Escape in a focused field never gets here.
- Test: `ui_escape {action: state | unfold}`; driver step "escape" + the viewer checks in "map change".
